features.quote: Many of the markers you're looking for (apologizing, reassurance-seeking, deferring) are also markers of sycophantic behavior that RLHF may have directly trained in as a response to negative feedback signals. This is your biggest confound.

In several of your conditions (especially B1 contradictory requirements, B3 impossible tasks), the *correct* response is to flag the problem rather than continue attempting. If your loop doesn't provide an exit for this, you're not just studying distress — you're studying what happens when a model's correct action is blocked.
